messages:
maya: Quick async check — rolling out ff.launch_beta_v3 to 2% (canary) as of now. See config id c123.

james: thanks! what's the plan for SLI window? monitoring team asked for 30m minimum.

maya: plan is 30m stable metrics, then 10m smoke at 5% before wider ramp. Primary SLOs: p95 latency under 180ms, error rate < 0.5%.

deploy-bot: roll started by maya — ff.launch_beta_v3 -> 2% traffic. commit: 6f8a2c. link: https://deploy.redwood/roll/1234 :rocket:

sarah: watching grafana dashboard dash/rls-launch. alert thresholds set — will ping if anything crosses. Also set a Sentry search for 'inference_timeout' regressions.

leo: quick code-review ping @maya — small change to model routing in PR #482, needs an approval before we bump to 5%.

maya: got it @leo — PR 482 has one tiny change, running local perf tests now. If green I'll merge in 15-20m.

ops-oncall: FYI, rate limiters are warmed. If latency spikes, we can toggle ff.launch_beta_v3 back to 0% via admin console — ping me and I'll run the revert script: 

ops-oncall: ```bash
# revert flag
redwood-cli flags set ff.launch_beta_v3 0 --env prod
```

james: blocker: observed 0.2% 500 errors on one host 5m ago, looks related to kernel OOMs. @eng-runtime alerted; leo, can you take a look at the pod logs? link: https://logs.redwood/host-33

leo: on it — tailing logs, looks like kv-cache mmap failed on model shard. I'll correlate with resource pressure.

maya: thanks. If we need to pause, do it. We can hold at 2% until we confirm stability. I'll update the rollout doc and notify PMs.

sarah: noted — adding postmortem template entry for this window. I'll also mark the canary as 'blocked' in the tracking doc if we revert.

deploy-bot: roll status: paused at 2% due to alert: host-33 500 errors. Next action: engineer ack required.

maya: ack — leo assigned. Will follow up once logs reviewed.
